notes: Classifier fixtures for AskWise. `expected` is the ground-truth ModeId. `stretch: true` marks known-hard cases (usually keyword-free paraphrases): track accuracy on them but exclude from the 85% gating threshold. Stretch cases are the target set for the embedding classifier. `note` explains why a case exists — several are deliberate precedence traps; if one fails, fix the rule order or lexicon, do not relabel the fixture to make the test pass. Taxonomy note (v3): quick_improve was narrowed to a residual catch-all (vague input, soft-skill advice, idea generation) when the learning / planning / marketing / business / finance / health / math_help / translation / image_gen modes were added. Fixtures re-labelled in that split were moved because the new mode is the better ground truth, not to make a test pass.
